title: An Infinite Family of 6_Regular B-Cayley Graphs from the Petersen Graph
summary: We construct an infinite family of 6-regular graphs $\{G_n\}_{n\ge 3}$ by taking $n$ copies of the Petersen graph and wiring corresponding vertices according to an $n$-cycle permutation. Each $G_n$ has $10n$ vertices, $30n$ edges, and automorphism group $D_{5n}$ of order $10n$, acting with two vertex orbits of size $5n$. The graphs have girth $4$ and diameter $\lfloor n/2\rfloor+2$. We prove that $G_3$ and $G_4$ are Ramanujan graphs, satisfying $|λ_2| \le 2\sqrt{5}$.
